pr_comment:
Added new MONDO term `MONDO:7770012` `SYCE1-related gametogenic failure` in `src/ontology/mondo-edit.obo`.

Rationale:
- The issue requested a single SYCE1-related disease entity spanning male and female gametogenic phenotypes.
- Existing MONDO already contained the sex-specific SYCE1 disease terms `MONDO:0014844` `premature ovarian failure 12` and `MONDO:0014847` `spermatogenic failure 15`.
- I modeled the new term as a broader gene-related reproductive disorder with asserted parents matching the request: `MONDO:0019852` inherited primary ovarian failure and `MONDO:0004983` spermatogenic failure.
- I also added `MONDO:0005039` reproductive system disorder plus the standard `has_material_basis_in_germline_mutation_in` relation to `HGNC:28852` (`SYCE1`).

Definition and sourcing:
- Definition text follows the issue description and existing MONDO modeling for sex-variable gene-related reproductive disorders.
- Added ClinGen Male Infertility GCEP attribution using `https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40073/`.
- Used `OMIM:616947` and `OMIM:616950` as sources for the ovarian and spermatogenic components, respectively, because those identifiers are already used by the existing SYCE1 child terms in MONDO.

Validation performed:
- Read the imported issue context from `__issue_context__.json`.
- Reviewed existing related terms in `src/ontology/mondo-edit.obo`, especially `MONDO:0014844`, `MONDO:0014847`, and the broader modeling precedent `MONDO:1060211` `NR5A1-related sex development disorder`.
- Confirmed the `SYCE1` HGNC identifier already in use in MONDO is `http://identifiers.org/hgnc/28852`.
- Confirmed `MONDO:7770012` was available in the local ID range.
- Ran a local syntax check with `robot convert --catalog src/ontology/catalog-v001.xml -i src/ontology/mondo-edit.obo -f obo -o /tmp/opencode/mondo-edit.TMP.obo`.

Environment limitation:
- I could not run the required ODK normalization command `make NORM` because `docker` is not installed in this evaluation environment.

- [x] Verified new MONDO ID availability
